text.title: Retro Format Rotation Guide Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete `RotationGuide` for a platform team that went async after three live formats and is rotated onto anonymous-async, with a note on every non-obvious value, and one bad guide showing what the validator prints and what the PM sees beyond it.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: The platform team ran mad-sad-glad on 2026-04-11 (5 actions, 7 participants, 1 silent), 4ls on 04-25 (6 actions, 8, 0) and sailboat on 05-09 (4 actions, 8, 0). Carol moved to Lisbon in May and the team no longer has an hour everyone can attend, so the distribution is now async. Ruslan writes the guide on 2026-05-16 for the retro due 05-23.

example.title: platform RotationGuide, 2026-05-16, next format anonymous-async
example.code: { "team_id": "platform", "owner": "Ruslan", "guide_date": "2026-05-16", "history": [ {"retro_date": "2026-05-09", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-05-09.json", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 4, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 0}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-25", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-04-25.json", "format": "4ls", "action_items": 6, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 0}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-11", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-04-11.json", "format": "mad-sad-glad", "action_items": 5, "participants": 7, "silent_participants": 1} ], "format_last_used": { "start-stop-continue": "2025-11-14", "sailboat": "2026-05-09", "4ls": "2026-04-25", "timeline": null, "anonymous-async": null, "mad-sad-glad": "2026-04-11", "lean-coffee": "2026-03-28" }, "team_state": {"distribution": "async", "fatigue_signal": "rotating"}, "stale_formats": [], "refresh_trend": {"consecutive_rotations_without_refresh": 1, "escalation": "none"}, "pick": { "next_format": "anonymous-async", "tie_breaker": "async_pool", "exception_recorded": false, "next_format_last_used": null, "anonymous_async_input": true }, "rationale": "Last three were sailboat, 4ls and mad-sad-glad, all live formats; distribution is now async since Carol moved to Lisbon, fatigue signal rotating. The async pool tie-breaker decides: anonymous-async is outside the last three, never used by this team, and the only pick that gets Lisbon's cards in.", "outcome_review": {"cadence": "next-retro", "last_run_at": "2026-05-09"} }
example.note: Every history entry points at a committed instance path and carries the three counts; the entries run 05-09, 04-25, 04-11, newest first, and `format_last_used` agrees with them (r-history-read-from-committed-instances, r-counts-recorded-per-scheduled-retro).

No format appears twice, no format was run twice in a row so the 50% drop signal cannot fire, and the last retro had 0 silent participants: `stale_formats` is empty and the validator recomputes the same (r-stale-format-detector-three-signals).

The rotation from 4ls to sailboat raised neither actions (6 to 4) nor contributors (8 to 8), so that is one unrefreshed rotation; the one before it (mad-sad-glad to 4ls) raised actions 5 to 6, so the count is 1, not 2, and no escalation is due (r-two-rotations-without-refresh-escalate-to-team-health).

anonymous-async is outside the last three and inside the async pool; mad-sad-glad and lean-coffee are excluded by the schema for an async team and `anonymous_async_input` is true (r-no-repeat-in-last-3, r-async-team-rotates-within-async-pool).

`rotating`, so the 12-month lookback does not apply; `next_format_last_used` is null because the team has never run it, and that matches `format_last_used` (r-fatigued-team-picks-format-unused-12-months).
The rationale names sailboat, 4ls and mad-sad-glad, "async", "rotating" and the async-pool tie-breaker; the validator looks for each of those strings (r-rationale-names-history-state-and-tiebreaker).

example.title: What the validator and the PM reject
example.code: { "team_id": "platform", "owner": "team", "guide_date": "2026-05-16", "history": [ {"retro_date": "2026-05-09", "instance_ref": "from memory", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 1, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 3}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-25", "instance_ref": "from memory", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 3, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 2}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-11", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-04-11.json", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 6, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 0} ], "format_last_used": { "start-stop-continue": "2026-01-16", "sailboat": "2026-05-09", "4ls": "2025-12-05", "timeline": null, "anonymous-async": null, "mad-sad-glad": "2026-02-13", "lean-coffee": "2026-03-13" }, "team_state": {"distribution": "async", "fatigue_signal": "fatigued"}, "stale_formats": [], "refresh_trend": {"consecutive_rotations_without_refresh": 0, "escalation": "none"}, "pick": { "next_format": "lean-coffee", "tie_breaker": "in_person_sailboat_or_lean_coffee", "exception_recorded": false, "next_format_last_used": "2026-03-13", "anonymous_async_input": false }, "rationale": "Everyone likes it and lean-coffee is a change.", "outcome_review": {"cadence": "next-retro", "last_run_at": "2026-05-09"} }
example.note: Validator output: `$.owner: matches forbidden 'not' schema`, `$.rationale: matches forbidden 'not' schema`, `$.pick.next_format: matches forbidden 'not' schema` (lean-coffee for an async team), `$.pick.anonymous_async_input: must equal True, got False`, `$.pick.tie_breaker: must equal 'fatigued_12_month_lookback', got 'in_person_sailboat_or_lean_coffee'`.

With those fixed (owner named, timeline picked with anonymous input and the 12-month tie-breaker, a rationale naming the history and state), the cross-field block still reports: `stale_formats: 'sailboat' is stale by signal twice_in_last_3 and is not listed (r-stale-format-detector-three-signals)` and `rationale must state when the picked format was last used (or that it never was) (r-fatigued-team-picks-format-unused-12-months)`. Had the pick stayed on a format used in 2026, it would also report the days-since-last-use against the 365-day lookback.

What the PM sees beyond the validator: two of the three history rows were typed from memory, so nobody knows whether the 04-25 retro was really sailboat; action items fell 6, 3, 1 and silent participants rose 0, 2, 3 across three identical retros, which is the detector's first signal and its third at once; and the "change" on offer is lean-coffee for a team that now has no overlap hour, decided by a tie-breaker written for in-person teams.
